title: Wakesurf Lovers
synopsis:
Amidst a rising wakesurfing craze, surf instructor Man (Renci Yeung) is falsely accused and publicly shamed online. Among the trolls is Chuan (Jeffrey Ngai), a surfing novice whose satirical video mocking her goes viral. Upon realizing the rumors were entirely fabricated and that he has ruined her reputation, a guilt-ridden Chuan signs up for Man's lessons under his real identity to make amends.


As they connect beyond the digital noise, a genuine romance blossoms. To clear her name, Chuan devises a plan to expose the disgruntled student who started the smear campaign, while encouraging Man to reclaim her professional standing by challenging celebrity coach Joe (Kevin Chu).

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
Wakesurf衝浪熱潮下，教練孫漫（楊偲泳飾）卻因為教學方法而被網絡公審，跟風謾罵者眾，其中一個正是青年阿川（魏浚笙飾）！阿川對衝浪一竅不通，但以網名「太平洋白鮓王」發表的嘲諷短片竟被瘋傳！他沾沾自喜之際，卻發現孫漫原來是被謠傳抹黑；自以為伸張正義的帖子，卻令她身敗名裂。 


為了贖罪，阿川以真實身份找孫漫學習衝浪，不再被網絡假消息與片面評價影響，逐漸了解真實的她；同時孫漫亦對爽朗熱情的阿川產生好感，兩人逐漸走進對方生命，相知相交。阿川希望平反外界對孫漫的誤解，施計令那個「惡客學員」（陳楨怡飾）澄清真相，更鼓勵孫漫挑戰星級教練Joe（朱鑑然飾）！
